locations.label: Mister Peeks — Normal Nuketown · north of Cul-de-Sac
locations.description: Possible Cursed-mode Mister Peeks egg-reward spawn on an off-map roof north of Cul-de-Sac. The published spawn is cropped beyond the upper edge of the Past map image; this marker identifies the nearby search area, not the exact roof position. Look above/outside the playable boundary. Shoot Mister Peeks when he appears to release a reward egg; perks are possible rewards, not guaranteed.
